turns.question: It's 10 November 2026. How many orders did we get last fiscal quarter, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: 217 orders (cancelled included) were placed in the last fiscal quarter, 1 August to 31 October 2026 (fiscal Q3 of fiscal 2026, since the current quarter began on 1 November). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
